name: horizontal-leg-raise.html
instructions:
1. Position yourself on the Roman chair with your back against the pad and your legs hanging straight down.
2. Grip the handles for support. This is the starting position.
3. Lift your legs toward the ceiling by squeezing your lower abs. Keep your legs straight as you raise them.
4. Stop when your legs are about parallel to the floor or higher if you can.
5. Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position with control, avoiding letting them drop quickly. This is one rep.
6. Perform the desired number of reps, focusing on keeping your core engaged throughout the movement.
